items.criterion: A decision row records the branch version the approval was taken against.
items.judgment: Read the decision after an approval and confirm the stored version equals the branch's current version at the moment of the approval.

items.criterion: A push to an approved branch marks the live approval invalidated.
items.judgment: Store a new branch version after an approval, then read the decision and confirm the invalidation is recorded.

items.criterion: A merge attempted while the approval is invalidated is refused, leaving the main file with no merge version.
items.judgment: Call merge after an invalidating push and confirm both the refusal and the absence of a merge version on the main file.

items.criterion: A second approval against the current version lets the merge append exactly one merge version.
items.judgment: Approve again, merge, and count the merge versions on the main file.

items.criterion: A reviewer outside the file's team is refused on the decision endpoint.
items.judgment: Call the decision endpoint as the peer-team reviewer and confirm the refusal leaves the branch state unchanged.

items.criterion: A member holding the editor role is refused on the decision endpoint.
items.judgment: Call the decision endpoint with an editor session and confirm the refusal.

items.criterion: One review-request message reaches the named reviewer alone.
items.judgment: Read the mail service after a review request and confirm one message with the review-requested subject prefix addressed to the named reviewer.

items.criterion: Two frames inserted at one position under one parent are both stored.
items.judgment: Issue two inserts at the same position, then read the frame list and confirm both are present in one stable order.

items.criterion: A moved frame keeps its stored position across a reload.
items.judgment: Move a frame, re-read the file, and compare the stored geometry.

items.criterion: An update issued against the audit stream by the application role does not succeed.
items.judgment: Attempt an update on a recorded event through the application and confirm the stored row is unchanged.

items.criterion: A file in a team the caller does not belong to answers exactly as a file that does not exist.
items.judgment: Request the peer-team file and compare the answer with the answer for an unknown identifier.

items.criterion: The working area of every signed-in screen leads with a single primary action.
items.judgment: A person opens each signed-in screen and looks for exactly one control wearing the primary treatment.
